- This is a modular, generic React (Vite + TypeScript) dashboard project.
- Only Payments and Invoices are fetched from backend services (API), all other data is static but structured for easy future backend integration.
- All components should be pixel-perfect to the provided screenshot and ready for SaaS.
- Use services for all data access, even for static/mock data.
- Keep code clean, reusable, and ready for team collaboration.
